title: OSPF Watcher
host_requirements: Linux host with Docker, Docker Compose v2 and containerlab
git, curl and systemd; iptables and conntrack for GRE

modes.title: GRE
modes.description: The watcher forms an OSPF adjacency with one network device over a GRE tunnel and only listens: an XDP filter can drop anything it would advertise beyond the tunnel network.
router_requirements: GRE tunnel to the watcher host IP
OSPF on the tunnel, point-to-point, MTU 1476

modes.title: BGP-LS
modes.description: The router exports its OSPF database over a BGP-LS session to the watcher. No tunnel and no OSPF adjacency with the network.
router_requirements: BGP-LS (link-state address family) export of the OSPF database
TCP 179 between the router and the watcher host

router_examples.config:
router ospf 1
 distribute link-state
!
router bgp {bgpls_router_as}
 address-family link-state link-state
 !
 neighbor <watcher-host-ip>
  remote-as {bgpls_watcher_as}
  ! for eBGP: ebgp-multihop 255
  address-family link-state link-state

fields.label: Watcher AS number
fields.help: A different AS from the router's makes the session eBGP with multihop.

fields.label: Network device IP, tunnel source on the device
GRE tunnel IP on the network device, with mask
GRE tunnel IP on the watcher, with mask, same subnet
Watcher host IP, tunnel destination on the device
XDP filter: drop anything the watcher would advertise beyond the tunnel network
Passive mode: the router opens the session to TCP 179 of the watcher host
fields.help: One passive watcher per host, because it takes TCP 179.
